title: Technical debt assessment remediation (2026-06-30)
description:
Remediation of technical debt surfaced by the 2026-06-30 workflow-driven assessment of the gf2 workspace. The assessment audited all six crates against the project coding ideals (CLAUDE.md + scripts/code-review-prompt.md) and for documentation drift, producing 71 verified findings (1 critical, 6 high, 44 medium, 20 low) across 9 dimensions: tail-masking, unsafe-isolation, bitwise-arithmetic, functional-api, doc-completeness, test-conventions, msrv, ssot-duplication, separation-of-concerns, doc-drift.

The full report is attached to this epic via `jit doc list`.

## Scope

- **Critical/high (7 findings):** one task each, filed up front. These cover the single correctness hole (BitVec::from_words tail masking), the unsafe-doc isolation gap, the polar_transform performance regression, the CI-budget-breaking SimulationRunner tests, and three user-facing documentation-drift defects.
- **Medium/low (64 findings):** filed as a follow-up batch after scoping with the user; granularity and inclusion decided per dimension.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All 7 critical/high findings have dedicated task issues wired under this epic.
- [hard] The assessment report is linked to this epic via `jit doc add`.
- [hard] Every child task carries explicit, verifiable success criteria traceable to a report finding.
- The epic is `done` only when all child tasks are `done` or explicitly rejected with justification.
